text: Victoria, Australia, 2009. Bushfires had burned through the forest. Firefighter David Tree found a koala sitting in the ashes with *burnt paws.* He crouched down and offered her his water bottle. *She put her paw on his hand* and drank. Someone filmed it, and the world called her Sam. She was taken to a wildlife shelter, and *he went to visit her.* Hit like for the firefighters.
title: The Firefighter and the Thirsty Koala 🐨❤️
